newsitem.title: LATVIA: FINLAND MERITA TO ISSUE 15 MLN LAT BOND.
newsitem.headline: FINLAND MERITA TO ISSUE 15 MLN LAT BOND.

text.p: Finland's Merita bank said on Wednesday that it will become the first issuer of a bond in Latvia's currency, the lat, with a 15 million lat issue.
"Merita is going to issue a tap issue of 15 million lat bonds," Fanny Borgstrom, Merita's first vice-president, told Reuters.
She added that the bond's term is from April 14 1997 to July 14 1999 and that it would carry a nine percent coupon.
"We see enough commercial interest and economic development in Latvia to justify this tap issue," she said.
"The Baltic area is an important part of the bank's expansion strategy," she said.
Merita issued two bonds in Estonian kroons in 1995 and 1996.
